- **Soap** [`soap`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/soap.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. Fine soaps from Venice, Savona and Castile are traded; used for laundry, wool scouring and baths, not for medicine.
- **Distillation of strong alcohol (aqua vitae)** [`distillation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/distillation.md) — K3, use correct, make easy, accept high. Aqua vitae is made by apothecaries and monasteries as a medicine. Strength is variable; repeated distillation gives spirit that burns. Local: Taddeo Alderotti's writings; monasteries; Arte dei Medici e Speziali.
- **Sulphuric acid (oil of vitriol)** [`sulphuric_acid`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/sulphuric_acid.md) — K3, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Alchemists distil oil of vitriol from green vitriol in small, weak batches. Vitriol and sulphur are local. Bulk production is unknown. Local: alchemists; vitriol and sulphur from the Colline Metallifere and Volterra district.
- **Oxygen and combustion** [`oxygen_combustion`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/oxygen_combustion.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Fire is an element. Demonstration (candle under a glass over water) is easy, explaining it is hard. Isolating the gas needs mercury calx or saltpetre and gas handling.
- **Nitric acid (aqua fortis)** [`nitric_acid`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nitric_acid.md) — K3, use correct, make medium, accept high. Aqua fortis is distilled from saltpetre with vitriol or alum by goldsmiths and the mint to part gold from silver. Glass and clay retorts break often. Local: Zecca (mint); goldsmiths of Por Santa Maria.
- **Saltpetre from nitre beds** [`saltpetre_production`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/saltpetre_production.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Saltpetre is scraped from stable and cellar walls or imported through Venice; purity varies. Planned nitre beds are a German practice. Every state wants more powder. Local: gunpowder makers of the Signoria. Elsewhere: Germany, nitre plantations; India and the Levant, exports via Venice.
- **Chemical elements and conservation of mass** [`chemical_elements`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/chemical_elements.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept low. Four elements; metals grow from sulphur and mercury, so transmutation is plausible. Assayers have good balances and already rely on weight in practice. Local: assayers of the Zecca.
- **Atomic theory and fixed proportions** [`atomic_theory`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/atomic_theory.md) — K1, use none, make hard, accept low. Lucretius is back in circulation (found 1417, printed 1473) and read by humanists. Atoms mean Epicurus: godless and suspect. Proof by weight ratios needs pure reagents. Local: humanists of the Medici circle.
- **Molecules, Avogadro's hypothesis and chemical formulae** [`molecules_mole_concept`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/molecules_mole_concept.md) — K0, use none, make very-hard, accept low
- **Periodic table of the elements** [`periodic_table`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/periodic_table.md) — K0, use none, make very-hard, accept low. Only about a dozen of the elements are known as substances here, and none as elements. A table from memory would be unverifiable.
- **Gas laws (pressure, volume, temperature)** [`gas_laws`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/gas_laws.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. Scholastics debate the weight of air. Measuring how pressure varies with volume needs a sealed tube, mercury and a quantitative account of pressure.
- **Collecting and telling apart gases (hydrogen, fixed air)** [`pneumatic_chemistry_gases`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/pneumatic_chemistry_gases.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept medium. Different airs are not imagined; fumes are 'spirits'. Miners know choke-damp and fire-damp. Bladders, glass flasks, a water trough and acids are all at hand.
- **Acids, alkalis and indicators** [`acids_bases_ph`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/acids_bases_ph.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Dyers know that lye and urine turn orchil purple and sour liquors redden it. The Rucellai fortune comes from this lichen dye. No general concept of neutralising. Local: Rucellai family (oricello); dyers (tintori).
- **Hydrochloric acid and aqua regia** [`hydrochloric_acid_aqua_regia`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/hydrochloric_acid_aqua_regia.md) — K3, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Aqua regia (aqua fortis with sal ammoniac) is known to alchemists and some goldsmiths for dissolving gold. Spirit of salt by itself is not made. Local: goldsmiths; alchemists.
- **Alkalis (potash, soda, caustic lye)** [`alkali_soda`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/alkali_soda.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. Soda ash from Syria and Egypt (allume catina) and Spain feeds glass and soap; wood-ash lye is in every laundry. Soda and potash are not told apart. Elsewhere: Syria and Egypt, plant ash exports through Venice.
- **Lime burning and lime mortar** [`lime_burning`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/lime_burning.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high
- **Salt making (sea salt, brine boiling, rock salt)** [`salt_production`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/salt_production.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. State monopoly with a hated tax (gabella del sale). Brine is boiled at Volterra; sea salt comes from coastal pans. Local: Volterra salt springs (moie); salt pans near Pisa and in the Maremma.
- **Dyeing with mordants and vat dyes** [`mordant_dyeing`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/mordant_dyeing.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. Florentine dyers use alum with many dyes, including madder and kermes. Woad uses a vat process. Control of alum helped provoke the 1472 sack of Volterra. Local: Arte della Lana; Arte di Por Santa Maria (silk); Arte di Calimala; alum of Tolfa and Volterra.
- **Chlorine, bleaching powder and disinfection** [`chlorine_bleach`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/chlorine_bleach.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. Linen is bleached with lye, sour milk and months of sun. Chlorine needs spirit of salt plus manganese, which glassmakers stock as a decolouriser. The gas maims.
- **Electrolysis and electroplating** [`electrolysis`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/electrolysis.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. Needs a battery, and batteries are weak without zinc. Gilders would want plating: it replaces deadly mercury gilding.

- **Nitroglycerin and dynamite** [`nitroglycerin_dynamite`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nitroglycerin_dynamite.md) — K0, use none, make very-hard, accept medium. - **Petroleum refining (lamp oil, petrol)** [`petroleum_refining`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/petroleum_refining.md) — K2, use none, make medium, accept medium.
